name: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Limited is a Melbourne-based drug developer established in 1987 and formerly called Living Cell Technologies Limited. Its pipeline includes AI-116, a donepezil and cannabidiol combination for dementia, AI-168, a cannabinoid and off-patent drug blend for hypertension and other cardiovascular conditions, and NTCELL, an alginate-encapsulated product for Parkinson's disease.
